summary: A very long 16,500px audience page for accounting, audit and part-time CFO firms: a diagonal-photo head, a navy statement band, four audience cards, eight reasons, testimonial, three case cards, a software logo block in five labelled groups, a statement, CTA, resource cards, newsletter, contact, FAQ and a final banner.

sections.note: photo on the LEFT (a portrait cropped on a diagonal, 640px wide); right: orange small-caps tag, navy title, a two-line lead and one orange rectangular button.
navy band with a very large two-line statement (48px) and a short paragraph
three paragraphs of copy about the team's experience and sector knowledge
uppercase heading with paragraph; four tall cards (icon, title, a few lines, orange button) for each firm type
pale pink band: heading, a paragraph and eight reason tiles in two rows of four, each a small icon and a bold line
tag, uppercase heading, one quote with name and firm, arrow button, dots
uppercase heading; three case-study cards with a wide image, a title and a link
heading and a paragraph; five labelled groups of tool logos (accounting tools, management reports, audit tools, SMSF set-up, data collection), each label in orange with 3-6 colour logos
two paragraphs under a bold heading about adapting to the client's way of working
heading and one orange button (start engagement)
three white paper cards (cover image, title) with download links
newsletter sign-up: heading, one line and an email field
left: uppercase heading, a line and two buttons; right: a photo
uppercase heading; about ten questions in two columns, answers fully visible as plain text
full-width banner (1400 by 600) with a bold line and a button
